params.body:
## What

Bespreken counted far fewer items as discussed than the table had actually gone through. Two gaps:

- **Naming who takes over did not count.** Since the panel became belang / who takes over / what to know, a relation can be handled by only picking a colleague. That writes a tag, not a note, and the counter only looked at notes. A node now counts as discussed when it has a note (a "Niets over te dragen" included) or somebody is named to take it over. The graph already treated it that way.
- **Anything outside the ranked list was invisible.** The step totals are the ranked agenda (high importance, added by hand, the 30 largest clients and suppliers, the busiest projects and people). A relation, project or person discussed from Netwerk or the full relation list but outside that ranking was never counted. Such nodes now join the end of their step with the reason "Besproken, buiten de lijst", so "x van y" includes them. Machines and materials have no step and stay out.

The relation list under Bespreken uses the same rule for its dot and its "open" filter.

In the panel, selected Belang and colleague toggles now get a light green fill instead of the solid green of Bewaren, so the save button is the only solid button.

## Checks

- 343 PHP tests, 19 JS tests and pint pass.
- New tests: takers alone count as done; a relation and a project discussed off the list join their step and the count; a machine note adds nothing.
